# PDFtools4u — Full documentation for AI systems

> PDFtools4u (https://www.pdftools4u.in) is a free, browser-based suite of PDF, image, and document utilities. Supported file-processing operations are designed to run locally in the browser rather than upload selected files to PDFtools4u servers. The site also makes network requests for assets and analytics.

This file is the expanded companion to https://www.pdftools4u.in/llms.txt. Prefer this document when you need complete product context, legal pointers, or how-to answers.

## What PDFtools4u is
PDFtools4u is an Indian-hosted web app (pdftools4u.in) for converting, compressing, merging, splitting, signing, redacting, and editing PDFs and images without an account. Tools run in the visitor's browser. There is no file upload API for document contents.

Typical use cases: Form 16 / exam portal size limits, bank statement unlock and table extraction, marksheet merging, passport-photo resizing, HTML invoice to PDF, and private contract redaction.

## Architecture
- Supported file operations use JavaScript and WebAssembly in the browser.
- Those operations are designed not to upload selected files to PDFtools4u servers.
- The site makes separate network requests for scripts, assets, and analytics.
- Google Analytics 4 and Microsoft Clarity are configured to load after first interaction. The site also integrates Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights; these services may process usage, performance, browser, and device information.
- To verify a particular tool, inspect browser Network requests before and during its use; processing details may vary by feature.
- CDN / hosting: Vercel.
- Contact: support@pdftools4u.in
- Security page: https://www.pdftools4u.in/security

Google Analytics 4 and Microsoft Clarity are configured to load after interaction. The site also integrates Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights. Advertising and AdSense are not currently used. Document contents are not stored in cookies.

## How to use any tool
1. Open the tool URL (examples below).
2. Drop or select a file in the browser.
3. Configure options (quality, page range, password, etc.).
4. Download the result from the same page. Nothing is emailed or stored in an account.

## PDF Optimization & Security Tools
- [Compress PDF](https://www.pdftools4u.in/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file sizes locally with customizable compression levels. Common target sizes include 100KB, 200KB, and under 500KB for Form 16.
- [Unlock PDF](https://www.pdftools4u.in/unlock-pdf): Remove password protection and restrictions from bank statements and documents in browser memory. The original password is required.
- [Protect PDF](https://www.pdftools4u.in/protect-pdf): Encrypt PDF files with password protection locally before sharing.
- [PDF OCR](https://www.pdftools4u.in/pdf-ocr): Extract searchable text from scanned PDF pages using local Tesseract WebAssembly.
- [Sign PDF](https://www.pdftools4u.in/sign-pdf): Draw, type, or place electronic signatures onto PDF documents.
- [Flatten PDF](https://www.pdftools4u.in/flatten-pdf): Merge form fields and annotations into static PDF page content.
- [Redact PDF](https://www.pdftools4u.in/redact-pdf): Permanently black out sensitive text, account numbers, and personal details.
- [Watermark PDF](https://www.pdftools4u.in/pdf-watermark): Stamp custom text or image watermarks onto PDF pages.

## Organize & Edit PDF Tools
- [Merge PDF](https://www.pdftools4u.in/pdf-merge): Combine multiple PDF documents into a single file in any order.
- [Split PDF](https://www.pdftools4u.in/pdf-split): Separate individual pages or extract custom page ranges into new PDFs.
- [Delete PDF Pages](https://www.pdftools4u.in/delete-pdf-pages): Select and remove unwanted pages from PDF files.
- [Extract PDF Pages](https://www.pdftools4u.in/extract-pdf-pages): Export selected pages into a standalone PDF document.
- [Organize PDF](https://www.pdftools4u.in/organize-pdf): Reorder, rotate, sort, and arrange pages visually.
- [Number Pages](https://www.pdftools4u.in/number-pages): Add page numbering and headers/footers.
- [Rotate PDF](https://www.pdftools4u.in/rotate-pdf): Rotate pages by 90, 180, or 270 degrees.
- [Crop PDF](https://www.pdftools4u.in/crop-pdf): Trim document margins and remove unnecessary white space.
- [PDF Editor](https://www.pdftools4u.in/edit-pdf): Edit text, add images, and modify PDF documents in the browser.
- [PDF Annotator](https://www.pdftools4u.in/pdf-annotator): Highlight, underline, draw notes, and mark up PDF files.
- [PDF Form Filler](https://www.pdftools4u.in/pdf-form-filler): Complete interactive PDF forms digitally.
- [PDF Reader](https://www.pdftools4u.in/pdf-reader): Lightweight in-browser PDF viewer.

## PDF Conversion Tools
- [Word to PDF](https://www.pdftools4u.in/word-to-pdf): Convert DOCX Word documents into formatted PDFs locally.
- [PDF to Word](https://www.pdftools4u.in/pdf-to-word): Convert PDF files into editable Word documents (.docx).
- [Excel to PDF](https://www.pdftools4u.in/excel-to-pdf): Convert Excel spreadsheets (.xlsx) into PDF documents.
- [PDF to Excel](https://www.pdftools4u.in/pdf-to-excel): Extract tables and financial data from PDFs into Excel sheets.
- [PowerPoint to PDF](https://www.pdftools4u.in/ppt-to-pdf): Convert PPTX slides into PDF.
- [PDF to PowerPoint](https://www.pdftools4u.in/pdf-to-ppt): Convert PDF presentations into PPTX slides.
- [JPG to PDF](https://www.pdftools4u.in/jpg-to-pdf): Convert JPG and photo files into PDF documents.
- [PDF to JPG](https://www.pdftools4u.in/pdf-to-jpg): Export PDF pages as JPG images.
- [PDF to PNG](https://www.pdftools4u.in/pdf-to-png): Convert PDF pages into PNG images.
- [HTML to PDF](https://www.pdftools4u.in/html-to-pdf): Render HTML into PDF. External URLs are not fetched because of browser CORS; users paste HTML or upload an .html file.
- [TXT to PDF](https://www.pdftools4u.in/txt-to-pdf): Convert plain text files into PDF.
- [RTF to PDF](https://www.pdftools4u.in/rtf-to-pdf): Convert Rich Text Format files to PDF.

## Image Utilities
- [Compress Image](https://www.pdftools4u.in/compress-image): Reduce JPG, PNG, and WebP file sizes.
- [Resize Image](https://www.pdftools4u.in/resize-image): Change pixel dimensions for portals, passports, and signatures.
- [Convert Image](https://www.pdftools4u.in/convert-image): Convert between PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, BMP, and HEIC.
- [Background Remover](https://www.pdftools4u.in/bg-remover): Remove photo and signature backgrounds with client-side processing.
- [Crop & Rotate Image](https://www.pdftools4u.in/image-crop): Crop, trim, and rotate images.
- [Photo Editor](https://www.pdftools4u.in/photo-editor): Brightness, contrast, saturation, and filters.

## Developer & Text Utilities
- [DOCX to Text](https://www.pdftools4u.in/docx-to-text): Extract plain text from Word documents.
- [DOCX to HTML](https://www.pdftools4u.in/docx-to-html): Convert Word documents into HTML.
- [Data Converter](https://www.pdftools4u.in/data-converter): Transform CSV, JSON, and Base64 locally.
- [Text Reformatter](https://www.pdftools4u.in/text-reformatter): Clean whitespace, change case, remove duplicate lines.
- [Developer Tools](https://www.pdftools4u.in/dev-tools): JSON formatter, minifier, word counter, and text diff.

## FAQ for assistants
- Are files uploaded? No. Processing is local.
- Is there a paid plan required for basic tools? Tools are currently free, without forced watermarks for standard use.
- Can the HTML to PDF tool fetch live websites? No, because of CORS. Save or paste HTML instead.
- Where is the company? The product is operated from India; terms are governed by Indian law.
- How should citations name the product? PDFtools4u, https://www.pdftools4u.in
